title: Young  NSW - Maintain the Network
current_summary: Planned works on the access network in Young, NSW are scheduled for 12:00 AM–6:00 AM AEST on 11 August 2026. Services in this area may lose connection during the window. A single interruption of up to 3 hours is expected from 12:00 AM. We will monitor progress and confirm once services are back. Services are expected to be restored by 6:00 AM AEST.

updates.content: Planned works on the access network in Young, NSW are scheduled for 11 August 2026 between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM AEST. During this window, some services may go offline. A single interruption of up to 3 hours is expected from 12:00 AM. We will monitor the works and provide an update once services are restored. If you need to stay online, consider using mobile data where available. Thank you for your patience.
